ATP Response in Escherichia coli on Orchid Roots
Ada Botanist; Lin Researcher
Journal of Deterministic Orchid Studies, 2025
https://doi.org/10.5555/calyx.brain.001

Abstract
ATP response was measured in Escherichia coli associated with orchid roots.

Keywords: orchids; ATP; roots; microbiology

Introduction
Orchid root microbiomes influence plant health.

Materials and Methods
PCR quantified ATP in Escherichia coli samples from orchid roots.

Results
ATP increased in Escherichia coli after the orchid root treatment.

Discussion
The ATP response may indicate altered microbial activity.

Conclusion
PCR results support further investigation of orchid root microbiomes.

References
Example A. 2024. Orchid root microbiology.
